priya: Quick sync — Snowflake marketplace asked for a tenant-aware namespace mapping for our connector. Do we want to do tenant_prefix vs schema_per_tenant?
omar: tenant_prefix seems simplest, less migration friction. but need to confirm upper limit on table counts per tenant.
elaine: Snowflake partner team prefers schema_per_tenant for clearer RBAC, but they can accept prefix if we emit a manifest mapping.
chris: from runtime side, prefix is fine. just need to ensure KV cache keys include tenant_id to avoid collisions.
marco: note on throughput — Databricks side requested burst up to 500rps for batch ingest during demo. our Dedicated config can handle bursts with autoscale but we should document autoscale cooldowns.
jeff: +1 on documenting cooldowns. Also, marketplace listing needs: sample manifest, provenance doc, minimum compute profile, and a privacy/data flow diagram.
priya: here's a draft mapping config we could include in the manifest:
```yaml
namespace_mapping:
  type: prefix
  tenant_prefix: "rd_{{tenant_id}}_"
  max_tables_per_tenant: 200
  require_provenance: true
```
omar: that max_tables number ok? it's conservative but avoids runaway metadata. we can increase later if field trial shows need.
elaine: legal/security wants an explicit note about role separation and KMS scopes when using prefix mode.
chris: will add a runtime flag `--tenant-isolation=prefix|schema` so Private customers can opt in.
marco: for vector DBs (Qdrant/Milvus) we need to add namespace into collection name too. recommendation: `rd_{tenant_id}__{collection}` to avoid collisions.
jeff: marketplace QA will run e2e flow: create tenant -> push sample bundle -> query -> delete tenant. Need owners for each step.
priya: owners: runtime/eng (chris) for flag + tests, partnerships (priya) for manifest, eng-ml (marco) for vector naming and perf, legal (elaine) for prov docs, ops (omar) for autoscale policy.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: connector-integ -> staging on 2025-02-18T10:00Z (canary).
chris: timeline check: I can have flag + unit tests by EOD Friday (1754400000). integration tests next week.
omar: ops will propose autoscale policy: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=8, scale_window=60s. Will share YAML.
priya: action items: (1) chris add flag + KV-key change (2) marco update vector naming + perf tests (3) jeff assemble manifest template + sample bundle (4) elaine legal checklist (5) omar autoscale YAML.
marco: one more thing — for hardware partners packaging, add a note that connectors must run with `--offline-cache` enabled and include checksum for package.
priya: good call. i'll add packaging note to marketplace docs.
jeff: i'll create the marketplace checklist card in Asana and link here when ready.
priya: thanks everyone :rocket: let's reconvene Wed 9am PT if we have PRs to review.
